trigger: Find Dr. Ames in the east wing.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Gurneys in the hall. Generators in the parking ramp, some dead. A man in scrubs, coat over them.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: Ames. Talk fast. What are you, what do you need.

nodes.speaker: dell
nodes.text: Insulin. Priority card. My son, fifteen.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: Tier two. Two vials, Lantus. Stay cool, not frozen. Not frozen. People freeze it.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: Next. No, wait. You're the lineworker. The registry flagged you.

nodes.speaker: dell
nodes.text: Insulin. For my son. No card.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: Then no. Card, or I give it to a kid with a card. Unless.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: My B generator is dry. There's a tanker truck in the ramp, level three. Drained, mostly.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: Someone's living up there. Get me what's left in it and I'll find a vial with no paperwork.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: Squatters. Kids, probably. They shot at a porter. I don't judge. I need diesel.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: Yes or no. People are dying in alphabetical order down here.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: Good. Don't die. I'd have to do paperwork.
